M01.intro: First Flight, you have the pad. Take the pod past 100 km.
M01.flying: Liftoff confirmed. Keep the nose up and watch your altitude.

M02.intro: Go for orbit. Both altitude markers must meet the brief for two seconds.
M02.flying: Climb first, then build sideways speed. Watch AP and PE in Orbit view.

M03.intro: Survey payload aboard. The approach is set. Coast through the corridor and back out.
M03.flying: Gold is the coast track. The lunar marker shows the projected closest pass.

M04.intro: Aim for the marked landing zone. Deploy the legs and brake early.
M04.flying: Touchdown limits are 8 m/s vertical, 5 m/s sideways and 20° tilt.
